title: Python IndentationError
symptom: Python script stops before running a function.
labContext: Intro Python lab: define and call a function.
rootCauseSummary: A block statement has inconsistent indentation.
fixRecommendation: Use consistent indentation, preferably four spaces, and inspect the preceding block.

title: Python NameError
symptom: A calculation fails because a variable is reported as undefined.
rootCauseSummary: The variable is misspelled or used before assignment.
fixRecommendation: Compare the identifier spelling and ensure assignment occurs before use.

title: Python TypeError in arithmetic
symptom: Adding user input to a number raises an exception.
consoleOutput: TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "int") to str
rootCauseSummary: input() returns text, so a string is combined with an integer.
fixRecommendation: Convert validated input using int() or float() before arithmetic.

title: Python IndexError
symptom: Processing the final item crashes a loop.
consoleOutput: IndexError: list index out of range
rootCauseSummary: An index reaches the list length, which is outside valid indices.
fixRecommendation: Iterate over elements or use range(len(items)); check loop bounds.

title: Python KeyError
symptom: A record lookup fails for one user.
rootCauseSummary: The requested dictionary key is absent.
fixRecommendation: Inspect available keys and use get() or validate the key.

title: Python ZeroDivisionError
symptom: A statistics calculation crashes when a group is empty.
rootCauseSummary: The denominator can be zero for empty input.
fixRecommendation: Check the denominator and define behavior for an empty group.

title: Python file not found
symptom: A script cannot read a provided CSV file.
rootCauseSummary: The working directory differs from the file location or the path is wrong.
fixRecommendation: Print the working directory and use a verified absolute or project-relative path.

title: Python CSV encoding issue
symptom: Names with accents become unreadable.
rootCauseSummary: The file encoding is not decoded as expected.
fixRecommendation: Open the file with the documented encoding, often utf-8-sig for exported CSV.

title: Python mutable default argument
symptom: One function call unexpectedly changes the next result.
consoleOutput: Second call returns values from the first call
rootCauseSummary: A mutable default list is shared between calls.
fixRecommendation: Use None as the default and create a new list inside the function.

title: Python shallow copy bug
symptom: Editing a copied nested record changes the original.
rootCauseSummary: A shallow copy retains references to nested mutable objects.
fixRecommendation: Copy nested structures intentionally or use a suitable deep copy.

title: Python infinite while loop
symptom: A menu never exits after a user enters a valid choice.
rootCauseSummary: The loop condition variable is not updated on the exit path.
fixRecommendation: Trace the condition and ensure every intended exit path updates state or breaks.

title: Python recursion limit
symptom: Recursive traversal fails on a deep structure.
rootCauseSummary: Recursion depth grows without an adequate base case or iterative strategy.
fixRecommendation: Verify base cases and consider an explicit stack for deep inputs.

title: Python async task exception lost
symptom: An async workflow reports success although a child task failed.
rootCauseSummary: Task exceptions are not awaited or collected.
fixRecommendation: Await tasks and propagate or handle exceptions explicitly.

title: Java NullPointerException
symptom: A method call fails for a record with a missing optional field.
rootCauseSummary: A reference is null when dereferenced.
fixRecommendation: Trace object construction and validate nullability before dereferencing.

title: Java ConcurrentModificationException
symptom: Removing items during a for-each loop crashes.
rootCauseSummary: The collection is structurally modified outside the iterator.
fixRecommendation: Use Iterator.remove(), removeIf(), or collect removals separately.

title: Java equals versus ==
symptom: Two equal strings fail a comparison.
consoleOutput: Expected "PASS" but branch was not entered
rootCauseSummary: == compares object identity rather than string content.
fixRecommendation: Use equals() for content comparison and handle null safely.

title: C array buffer overflow
symptom: Input corrupts nearby memory or crashes.
rootCauseSummary: Input length exceeds the destination buffer capacity.
fixRecommendation: Bound input length and validate array indices; use safe library patterns.

title: C segmentation fault
symptom: Program crashes while traversing a linked list.
rootCauseSummary: A null or invalid pointer is dereferenced.
fixRecommendation: Inspect pointer initialization and list termination using a debugger.

title: Kotlin nullability mismatch
symptom: A Kotlin call fails when a Java API returns null.
rootCauseSummary: A platform type is treated as guaranteed non-null.
fixRecommendation: Model nullable values explicitly and validate before use.

title: Kotlin coroutine stale search result
symptom: Older search results replace results for a newer query.
rootCauseSummary: Concurrent requests finish out of order and stale results are applied.
fixRecommendation: Use debounce with flatMapLatest or cancel the previous job.

title: Java stack overflow in tree traversal
symptom: A tree traversal repeatedly visits the same node.
rootCauseSummary: Traversal lacks a base case or visited guard for cyclic references.
fixRecommendation: Add correct termination and track visited nodes when graph cycles are possible.

title: Java resource leak
symptom: Repeated file processing eventually exhausts handles.
rootCauseSummary: Streams are not closed on all code paths.
fixRecommendation: Use try-with-resources and ensure resource ownership is clear.

title: C++ use-after-free
symptom: Program crashes after an object is deleted.
rootCauseSummary: A stale pointer is used after its allocation is released.
fixRecommendation: Use RAII and smart pointers; avoid retaining invalid references.

title: Floating-point equality bug
symptom: A decimal calculation fails an equality check.
rootCauseSummary: Binary floating-point cannot represent some decimal fractions exactly.
fixRecommendation: Compare within a documented tolerance or use decimal arithmetic for money.

title: Unit test passes locally but fails in CI
symptom: A test depends on machine-specific state.
consoleOutput: Expected file exists locally but missing on CI runner
rootCauseSummary: The test assumes local paths, timezone, ordering, or environment variables.
fixRecommendation: Remove environment assumptions and configure deterministic test fixtures.

title: SQL JOIN duplicate rows
symptom: A customer report contains repeated customer names after joining orders.
consoleOutput: 45 rows returned when 15 customers were expected
rootCauseSummary: A one-to-many relationship produces one result row per matching order.
fixRecommendation: Confirm cardinality; use DISTINCT or EXISTS only when the required output is customer-level.

title: SQL INNER JOIN missing records
symptom: Some students disappear from a report.
rootCauseSummary: INNER JOIN excludes rows without a matching record.
fixRecommendation: Check unmatched keys and use LEFT JOIN if unmatched students must remain.

title: SQL NULL comparison
symptom: A query does not find rows where a field is empty.
consoleOutput: WHERE phone = NULL returns zero rows
rootCauseSummary: NULL is not equal to a value, including NULL.
fixRecommendation: Use IS NULL or IS NOT NULL and account for three-valued logic.

title: SQL GROUP BY error
symptom: Aggregate query fails under strict SQL mode.
consoleOutput: Expression is not in GROUP BY clause
rootCauseSummary: Selected non-aggregated columns are not grouped or aggregated.
fixRecommendation: Group by all required non-aggregated columns or revise the query.

title: SQL foreign key violation
symptom: Inserting an enrollment fails.
consoleOutput: Cannot add or update a child row: foreign key constraint fails
rootCauseSummary: The referenced student key does not exist or is inserted in the wrong order.
fixRecommendation: Verify parent record and key values before inserting the child row.

title: SQL unique constraint violation
symptom: A new account cannot be inserted.
rootCauseSummary: A value duplicates a column protected by a unique constraint.
fixRecommendation: Check whether the record already exists and choose a deliberate update or rejection policy.

title: SQL transaction changes lost
symptom: A transfer appears successful but balances revert.
rootCauseSummary: The transaction was rolled back or never committed.
fixRecommendation: Check transaction boundaries, error handling, and commit only after all checks pass.

title: SQL deadlock between transfers
symptom: Two concurrent transactions wait on each other.
consoleOutput: Deadlock found when trying to get lock; transaction rolled back
rootCauseSummary: Transactions acquire locks in conflicting orders, creating a cycle.
fixRecommendation: Acquire resources in a consistent order, keep transactions short, and retry deadlock victims safely.

title: SQL lock wait timeout
symptom: An UPDATE waits and eventually times out.
rootCauseSummary: Another transaction holds a conflicting lock or a transaction remains open.
fixRecommendation: Inspect active transactions and lock waits; shorten transactions and add indexes where justified.

title: SQL slow query full scan
symptom: A query over a large table is unexpectedly slow.
consoleOutput: EXPLAIN shows type=ALL on a large table
rootCauseSummary: The plan scans many rows because filtering or join columns lack useful indexes.
fixRecommendation: Use EXPLAIN, inspect selectivity, and add an index only after validating workload impact.

title: SQL ambiguous column name
symptom: A joined query fails on a shared column name.
rootCauseSummary: Both tables contain the referenced column and it is unqualified.
fixRecommendation: Qualify columns with table aliases.

title: SQL incorrect date filtering
symptom: Rows from the final day are omitted.
consoleOutput: WHERE created_at <= 2026-10-19 returns only midnight at boundary
rootCauseSummary: A datetime range ends at midnight or converts time zones unexpectedly.
fixRecommendation: Use a half-open range with an exclusive next-day boundary and confirm timezone semantics.

title: SQL DELETE without intended filter
symptom: A cleanup query removes too many rows.
rootCauseSummary: The WHERE predicate is missing or too broad.
fixRecommendation: Preview affected rows in a transaction and verify predicates before deletion.

title: SQL connection refused
symptom: An application cannot connect to the database server.
rootCauseSummary: Service is stopped, host/port is wrong, or network binding blocks the client.
fixRecommendation: Check service status, listening port, host configuration, and network policy.

title: SQL authentication denied
symptom: A valid-looking app cannot log in to the database.
consoleOutput: Access denied for user from client host
rootCauseSummary: Credentials, host-based grants, or authentication plugin do not match.
fixRecommendation: Verify account host, secret source, grants, and supported authentication method.

title: SQL migration schema drift
symptom: Code expects a column absent from the deployed database.
rootCauseSummary: Migration was skipped or environments are at different schema versions.
fixRecommendation: Check migration history and apply versioned migrations in order.

title: SQL pagination duplicates
symptom: Records repeat between consecutive pages while data changes.
rootCauseSummary: Offset pagination is unstable without deterministic ordering.
fixRecommendation: Use deterministic ordering with a unique tie-breaker; consider keyset pagination.

title: SQL incorrect count with LEFT JOIN
symptom: A count is higher than the number of parent entities.
consoleOutput: COUNT(*)=74 while parent table contains 30 entities
rootCauseSummary: COUNT(*) counts joined child rows rather than distinct parents.
fixRecommendation: Count the parent key distinctly or aggregate children separately.

title: SQL isolation anomaly
symptom: A report reads inconsistent values during concurrent updates.
consoleOutput: Repeated read returns different committed values
rootCauseSummary: Transaction isolation level permits the observed anomaly or reads occur across transactions.
fixRecommendation: Define consistency requirements and choose an appropriate isolation level.

title: SQL injection risk in query building
symptom: A search input changes the meaning of a query.
consoleOutput: Input containing quote changes WHERE clause behavior
rootCauseSummary: User input is concatenated into SQL text.
fixRecommendation: Use parameterized statements and least-privilege database accounts.

title: TCP connection refused on port 8080
symptom: A client cannot connect to a REST API on port 8080.
consoleOutput: curl: connect to host 192.168.1.50 port 8080: Connection refused
rootCauseSummary: No process is listening on the target interface/port, or the service actively rejects the connection.
fixRecommendation: Check service status and listening sockets, then verify bind address and destination.

title: DNS name resolution failure
symptom: A hostname cannot be reached although the server IP responds.
rootCauseSummary: Resolver configuration or DNS record is incorrect or unavailable.
fixRecommendation: Inspect resolver settings and query the configured DNS server.

title: Wrong default gateway
symptom: A host reaches local peers but not remote networks.
consoleOutput: ping local host succeeds; remote destination unreachable
rootCauseSummary: The default route points to an invalid gateway or wrong subnet.
fixRecommendation: Inspect routing table and configure the correct reachable gateway.

title: Subnet mask mismatch
symptom: Two hosts on a flat LAN cannot communicate as expected.
rootCauseSummary: Their subnet masks place the peer in different IP subnets.
fixRecommendation: Calculate network IDs from address and mask, then align configuration with the lab design.

title: Duplicate IP address
symptom: Connectivity drops intermittently for one workstation.
consoleOutput: Duplicate IP address detected on interface eth0
rootCauseSummary: Two devices use the same IPv4 address.
fixRecommendation: Check DHCP leases and ARP entries, then assign unique addresses.

title: Firewall blocks TCP port
symptom: Service is listening but remote clients time out.
consoleOutput: Connection times out; service listens on 0.0.0.0:8443
rootCauseSummary: Host or network firewall drops incoming traffic to the port.
fixRecommendation: Inspect firewall rules and permit only the required source, protocol, and port.

title: Server bound to loopback
symptom: A service works locally but not from another VM.
rootCauseSummary: The service listens only on 127.0.0.1.
fixRecommendation: Bind to the intended interface and apply appropriate access controls.

title: TCP port already in use
symptom: A development server fails to start.
rootCauseSummary: Another process owns the requested local port.
fixRecommendation: Identify the owning process and use a controlled stop or a different configured port.

title: Incorrect VLAN assignment
symptom: A workstation cannot reach devices in its assigned department.
consoleOutput: Host obtains address from unexpected subnet
rootCauseSummary: Switch access port is assigned to the wrong VLAN or trunk configuration is inconsistent.
fixRecommendation: Verify access VLAN, trunk allowed VLANs, and gateway interface.

title: Routing table missing route
symptom: One subnet is unreachable while others work.
rootCauseSummary: No matching route exists or a more-specific incorrect route wins.
fixRecommendation: Inspect route selection and add the correct route at the appropriate layer.

title: Packet loss on Wi-Fi
symptom: Remote sessions freeze and ping latency spikes.
rootCauseSummary: Wireless interference, weak signal, congestion, or link errors affect delivery.
fixRecommendation: Compare wired and wireless tests, signal quality, and packet loss over time.

title: MTU path issue
symptom: Small requests work but larger transfers stall.
consoleOutput: TLS handshake stalls only on larger packets
rootCauseSummary: Path MTU or blocked fragmentation-needed messages prevent large packets.
fixRecommendation: Test path MTU and correct interface/tunnel MTU or filtering.

title: TCP handshake fails
symptom: SYN packets are sent without successful connection establishment.
consoleOutput: Repeated SYN retransmissions in packet capture
rootCauseSummary: Return route, firewall, listener, or address configuration is broken.
fixRecommendation: Capture traffic at both ends and determine whether SYN, SYN-ACK, or ACK is missing.

title: TLS certificate hostname mismatch
symptom: HTTPS client rejects a development endpoint.
consoleOutput: certificate is valid for api.lab.local, not 192.168.1.20
rootCauseSummary: Certificate SAN does not match the hostname used by the client.
fixRecommendation: Use the correct hostname and a certificate with matching SAN; do not disable verification.

title: HTTP proxy misconfiguration
symptom: Browser works but command-line requests fail.
rootCauseSummary: Proxy environment variables point to an unavailable or inappropriate proxy.
fixRecommendation: Inspect proxy variables and configure bypass rules for local lab hosts.

title: DHCP address not obtained
symptom: A host receives an APIPA address or no usable address.
rootCauseSummary: DHCP service, relay, VLAN path, or address pool is unavailable.
fixRecommendation: Inspect DHCP discover/offer traffic, VLAN and pool exhaustion.

title: NAT port forwarding failure
symptom: External test client cannot reach a service inside a lab network.
consoleOutput: Internal curl succeeds; external connection times out
rootCauseSummary: Forwarding rule, destination address, or upstream filtering is wrong.
fixRecommendation: Verify internal listener, NAT mapping, return route, and allowed exposure.

title: UDP service appears unavailable
symptom: UDP client gets no response and assumes server is down.
consoleOutput: nc -u sends data but receives no reply
rootCauseSummary: UDP has no connection handshake; application, firewall, or response path may be responsible.
fixRecommendation: Check server socket, packet capture, protocol payload, and return traffic.

title: Network loop causes broadcast storm
symptom: Switch network becomes unstable after a cabling change.
consoleOutput: Broadcast traffic spikes immediately after cable change
rootCauseSummary: A Layer 2 loop creates repeated frame circulation.
fixRecommendation: Remove the redundant path safely and inspect spanning-tree status.

title: Incorrect IPv6 route
symptom: IPv6 connectivity fails although IPv4 works.
consoleOutput: No route to host for IPv6 destination
rootCauseSummary: IPv6 address, router advertisement, neighbor discovery, or route is missing.
fixRecommendation: Inspect IPv6 address and route tables, then test neighbor discovery.

title: Process starvation
symptom: A low-priority process rarely receives CPU time.
rootCauseSummary: Higher-priority runnable processes repeatedly preempt it.
fixRecommendation: Inspect scheduler policy and consider fair scheduling or bounded priority boosts.

title: Deadlock from circular wait
symptom: Two threads each hold a lock and wait for the other.
consoleOutput: Thread A waits for lock B; Thread B waits for lock A
rootCauseSummary: Locks are acquired in inconsistent order, creating a wait cycle.
fixRecommendation: Acquire locks in a consistent global order or use a safe locking strategy.

title: Race condition in shared counter
symptom: Concurrent increments produce a lower total than expected.
rootCauseSummary: Read-modify-write operations are not atomic or synchronized.
fixRecommendation: Use a mutex, atomic primitive, or suitable concurrency-safe design.

title: Memory thrashing
symptom: System spends most time paging and throughput collapses.
consoleOutput: High swap-in/swap-out and low useful CPU throughput
rootCauseSummary: Active working sets exceed available physical memory.
fixRecommendation: Reduce concurrent memory demand and improve locality; measure page faults and swap activity.

title: Page replacement anomaly experiment
symptom: Increasing frames unexpectedly increases faults for a reference string.
consoleOutput: FIFO faults increase from 9 to 10 when frames increase
rootCauseSummary: FIFO can exhibit Belady’s anomaly for certain reference strings.
fixRecommendation: Verify the algorithm and reference string; compare with stack algorithms such as LRU.

title: Zombie processes accumulate
symptom: Process table contains many defunct child processes.
rootCauseSummary: Parent has not collected terminated child exit statuses.
fixRecommendation: Fix parent process to wait/reap children and handle SIGCHLD appropriately.

title: Orphan process behavior misunderstood
symptom: A child continues after its parent exits.
rootCauseSummary: Parent termination does not automatically terminate every child.
fixRecommendation: Inspect process tree and implement explicit lifecycle management if required.

title: Permission denied on executable
symptom: A shell script cannot be launched.
rootCauseSummary: Execute permission is missing or filesystem is mounted noexec.
fixRecommendation: Inspect mode bits and mount options; grant only necessary permission.

title: Disk full despite small files
symptom: Applications fail to write although visible files seem small.
rootCauseSummary: Filesystem blocks or inodes are exhausted, or deleted files remain open.
fixRecommendation: Check df -h and df -i; identify large open deleted files safely.

title: Deadlock avoidance unsafe state
symptom: Banker’s algorithm denies a request that seems to fit available memory.
consoleOutput: No safe sequence found for proposed allocation
rootCauseSummary: The request may leave no safe completion sequence.
fixRecommendation: Recompute Need, Available, and the safe sequence before granting.

title: Priority inversion
symptom: High-priority task waits behind a low-priority lock holder.
consoleOutput: High-priority task blocked by low-priority mutex owner
rootCauseSummary: Medium-priority work prevents the lock holder from running.
fixRecommendation: Use priority inheritance/ceiling where supported and keep critical sections short.

title: Semaphore count incorrect
symptom: A producer-consumer program hangs or overruns a buffer.
consoleOutput: Consumer waits forever despite buffered items
rootCauseSummary: Wait/post ordering or initial semaphore values are wrong.
fixRecommendation: Define buffer invariants and validate empty/full/mutex semaphore operations.

title: Context-switch overhead too high
symptom: Adding more threads reduces throughput.
consoleOutput: Throughput falls as thread count rises from 8 to 256
rootCauseSummary: Excessive runnable threads increase scheduling and synchronization overhead.
fixRecommendation: Measure thread count and workload; use bounded pools and reduce contention.

title: Copy-on-write memory misunderstanding
symptom: Forked processes initially share memory but memory use later grows.
consoleOutput: RSS increases after child modifies large array
rootCauseSummary: Writes create private copies of modified pages.
fixRecommendation: Measure resident set and distinguish virtual memory from physical sharing.

title: Page fault mistaken for fatal error
symptom: A program is assumed broken when a page fault occurs.
consoleOutput: Page-fault counter increases during normal file mapping
rootCauseSummary: A page fault can be a normal mechanism for loading mapped pages.
fixRecommendation: Distinguish handled minor/major faults from invalid memory access.

title: File descriptor leak
symptom: Long-running process eventually cannot open files or sockets.
rootCauseSummary: Descriptors are not closed after use.
fixRecommendation: Trace descriptor counts and close owned descriptors on every path.

title: Signal handler unsafe operation
symptom: Program deadlocks after receiving a signal.
consoleOutput: Process hangs after SIGCHLD handler executes
rootCauseSummary: Signal handler calls non-async-signal-safe operations or locks.
fixRecommendation: Limit handler work to safe operations and defer processing to normal control flow.

title: Scheduler metric calculation wrong
symptom: Waiting time reported negative for a process.
rootCauseSummary: Arrival, burst, completion, and turnaround definitions are mixed.
fixRecommendation: Use turnaround=completion-arrival and waiting=turnaround-burst for non-preemptive examples.

title: Disk scheduling head movement error
symptom: SCAN algorithm total seek distance is inconsistent.
consoleOutput: Reported seek total differs from trace
rootCauseSummary: Direction and end-of-disk behavior are applied incorrectly.
fixRecommendation: Draw request order, state initial head position, and count each movement once.

title: Mutex not released after exception
symptom: Other threads block permanently after one task fails.
consoleOutput: Thread dump shows all workers BLOCKED on same monitor
rootCauseSummary: Lock release is not guaranteed on exceptional control flow.
fixRecommendation: Use scoped locking constructs or finally blocks to guarantee release.

title: Git merge conflict
symptom: A merge stops because two branches edit the same lines.
rootCauseSummary: Git cannot automatically combine overlapping edits.
fixRecommendation: Inspect conflict markers, resolve intended content, test, stage, and complete the merge.

title: Git push rejected non-fast-forward
symptom: Push is rejected because remote has commits missing locally.
rootCauseSummary: Local branch history does not contain the remote tip.
fixRecommendation: Fetch and integrate remote changes, resolve conflicts, then push.

title: Git detached HEAD
symptom: A commit is created but does not appear on the expected branch.
consoleOutput: You are in detached HEAD state
rootCauseSummary: HEAD points directly to a commit rather than a branch ref.
fixRecommendation: Create or switch to a named branch before continuing work.

title: Git changes on wrong branch
symptom: New work appears on main instead of feature branch.
rootCauseSummary: The developer started work while checked out to the wrong branch.
fixRecommendation: Inspect status and branch; use safe switch/restore/cherry-pick steps based on whether changes are committed.

title: Git accidentally staged secret
symptom: A credential file appears in staged changes.
rootCauseSummary: The file was added before ignore rules were configured.
fixRecommendation: Unstage it, add a suitable ignore rule, rotate exposed secrets, and verify history before sharing.

title: Git ignored file not appearing
symptom: A new file is absent from status.
consoleOutput: git status does not list config.local
rootCauseSummary: Ignore rule or global excludes hide the file.
fixRecommendation: Use git check-ignore -v to find the matching rule and deliberately force-add only if appropriate.

title: Git rebase conflict
symptom: Rebase pauses while replaying a commit.
rootCauseSummary: A replayed change overlaps with the current base.
fixRecommendation: Resolve files, stage them, continue the rebase, or abort if needed.

title: Git commit author incorrect
symptom: Commits show unexpected identity.
consoleOutput: git log shows an unexpected author email
rootCauseSummary: Repository or global user.name/user.email is configured incorrectly.
fixRecommendation: Inspect configuration scope and set the correct identity for future commits.

title: Git large file bloats repository
symptom: Clone and fetch become slow after committing binaries.
rootCauseSummary: Large generated artifacts are tracked in repository history.
fixRecommendation: Remove generated files from tracking; use appropriate artifact storage or Git LFS, considering history rewrite impacts.

title: Git cherry-pick conflict
symptom: A single commit cannot be applied cleanly.
rootCauseSummary: Target branch has diverged in overlapping code.
fixRecommendation: Resolve conflict and continue or abort cherry-pick.

title: Git reset risks losing work
symptom: A developer plans to reset but has uncommitted changes.
consoleOutput: git status shows modified source files
rootCauseSummary: Reset mode may overwrite or discard working-tree/index changes.
fixRecommendation: Inspect status, create a backup commit or stash, then choose reset mode deliberately.

title: Git submodule empty directory
symptom: Cloned project lacks dependency source in a submodule.
rootCauseSummary: Submodules were not initialized after cloning.
fixRecommendation: Initialize and update submodules using the project’s documented commit references.

title: Git case-only rename fails
symptom: Rename from File.kt to file.kt is not detected on a case-insensitive filesystem.
consoleOutput: git status does not show intended case change
rootCauseSummary: Filesystem case behavior differs from Git’s path handling.
fixRecommendation: Perform a two-step rename through a temporary name and verify status.

title: Git remote points to wrong repository
symptom: Push destination is an unrelated project.
consoleOutput: origin URL points to old project
rootCauseSummary: Remote URL is configured incorrectly.
fixRecommendation: Inspect git remote -v and correct the URL after confirming repository ownership.

title: Git revert versus reset confusion
symptom: A shared branch needs to undo a published commit.
consoleOutput: Commit is already pushed to shared main
rootCauseSummary: Reset rewrites branch history rather than adding an inverse commit.
fixRecommendation: Prefer git revert for published shared history unless team policy explicitly says otherwise.

title: HTTP 404 route missing
symptom: A frontend request returns 404 for an API endpoint.
rootCauseSummary: Requested path or HTTP method does not match a registered route.
fixRecommendation: Compare exact URL, method, base path, and router mounting configuration.

title: HTTP 401 authentication failure
symptom: A protected endpoint rejects a signed-in user.
rootCauseSummary: Token is missing, expired, malformed, or sent in the wrong header.
fixRecommendation: Inspect authorization header and token expiry without logging secrets.

title: HTTP 403 authorization failure
symptom: Authenticated user cannot access a resource.
rootCauseSummary: Identity is valid but lacks required permission or ownership.
fixRecommendation: Check role and resource-level authorization policy.

title: CORS preflight rejected
symptom: Browser blocks a cross-origin API request.
rootCauseSummary: Server does not allow the requesting origin, method, or headers.
fixRecommendation: Configure narrowly scoped CORS response headers and OPTIONS handling.

title: Frontend API base URL wrong
symptom: App works locally but deployed frontend calls localhost.
rootCauseSummary: Production bundle contains development API URL.
fixRecommendation: Configure environment-specific API base URL and rebuild the deployment.

title: JavaScript undefined property
symptom: Page crashes while rendering a user profile.
rootCauseSummary: Data has not loaded or the expected nested property is absent.
fixRecommendation: Validate response shape and render loading/empty/error states.

title: React stale state update
symptom: Counter increments only once after multiple calls.
consoleOutput: setCount(count + 1) called repeatedly yields unexpected total
rootCauseSummary: State updates are batched and code reads a stale captured value.
fixRecommendation: Use functional state updates when the next state depends on the previous one.

title: React useEffect loop
symptom: Component repeatedly fetches data and re-renders.
consoleOutput: Network panel shows repeated identical requests
rootCauseSummary: Effect dependency changes on every render or updates its own dependency.
fixRecommendation: Stabilize dependencies and separate synchronization from derived state.

title: Form submits stale values
symptom: Submitted payload contains an earlier field value.
consoleOutput: Visible email differs from request payload
rootCauseSummary: Submission reads stale state or input is uncontrolled unexpectedly.
fixRecommendation: Use the current form state or FormData and validate at submit time.

title: JSON serialization mismatch
symptom: Backend rejects a request body.
rootCauseSummary: Property names, content type, or value types differ from API contract.
fixRecommendation: Inspect exact request payload and schema validation errors.

title: HTTP 500 from backend
symptom: Valid request fails with server error.
rootCauseSummary: Unhandled exception or dependency failure occurs server-side.
fixRecommendation: Correlate request ID with server logs and handle the failing dependency safely.

title: Cookie not sent cross-site
symptom: Session disappears in a cross-origin workflow.
rootCauseSummary: Cookie SameSite, Secure, domain, or credentials settings block it.
fixRecommendation: Align cookie attributes and client credentials with deployment security requirements.

title: Reverse proxy wrong upstream
symptom: App returns 502 after deployment.
rootCauseSummary: Proxy cannot reach the configured upstream service.
fixRecommendation: Check upstream address, service health, container network, and proxy logs.

title: WebSocket disconnects
symptom: Live dashboard stops receiving updates behind proxy.
rootCauseSummary: Upgrade headers, timeout, or heartbeat handling is missing.
fixRecommendation: Verify WebSocket proxy configuration, keepalive, and reconnect behavior.

title: Mixed content blocked
symptom: HTTPS page cannot load an HTTP API or image.
rootCauseSummary: Secure page attempts insecure active content.
fixRecommendation: Serve the resource over HTTPS and configure trusted certificates.

title: Cache serves stale API data
symptom: Updated profile remains old after refresh.
consoleOutput: Response age remains high after update
rootCauseSummary: Browser, CDN, or service worker caches a response too long.
fixRecommendation: Inspect cache headers and invalidate/version cached resources appropriately.

title: Pagination API skips records
symptom: Infinite scroll misses items between pages.
consoleOutput: Page cursor repeats or jumps unexpectedly
rootCauseSummary: Client increments cursor incorrectly or backend ordering is unstable.
fixRecommendation: Use server-provided cursor/next link and deterministic sort order.

title: File upload rejected
symptom: A valid file fails upload in production.
rootCauseSummary: Request size limit, multipart parsing, MIME validation, or storage permissions differ.
fixRecommendation: Check proxy/application limits and validate file type and size on the server.

title: Environment variable missing
symptom: Backend starts locally but crashes in deployment.
rootCauseSummary: Required configuration was not injected into runtime environment.
fixRecommendation: Validate required variables at startup and configure secrets in deployment settings.

title: Password reset token accepted twice
symptom: A reset link remains usable after changing password.
consoleOutput: Same reset token succeeds on repeated request
rootCauseSummary: Token is not invalidated or tracked as single-use.
fixRecommendation: Use short-lived, single-use tokens and invalidate them after successful reset.

title: Gradle dependency resolution failure
symptom: Android build cannot resolve a library.
rootCauseSummary: Repository configuration, version, network, or dependency coordinates are incorrect.
fixRecommendation: Check exact artifact coordinates, repositories, version catalog, and Gradle sync output.

title: Android manifest activity missing
symptom: App crashes when navigating to an undeclared activity.
rootCauseSummary: Activity is not declared or route configuration references the wrong destination.
fixRecommendation: Verify manifest declarations and navigation setup for the chosen architecture.

title: Compose state not recomposing
symptom: UI remains unchanged after a variable changes.
consoleOutput: Value changes in ViewModel but UI stays stale
rootCauseSummary: Mutable state is not observable by Compose.
fixRecommendation: Use mutableStateOf, StateFlow collection, or another observable state holder.

title: Compose list item state reused
symptom: Checkbox state moves to another row after sorting.
consoleOutput: Checked state appears on a different item after reorder
rootCauseSummary: LazyColumn items lack stable keys and state is associated by position.
fixRecommendation: Provide stable unique keys and keep item state associated with item identity.

title: Navigation argument missing
symptom: Detail screen receives an empty ID.
rootCauseSummary: Route argument name or encoding differs between navigation and destination.
fixRecommendation: Match route template and argument key, and encode path parameters.

title: Room main-thread query exception
symptom: Database access crashes during screen opening.
consoleOutput: Cannot access database on the main thread
rootCauseSummary: Blocking database query runs on the main thread.
fixRecommendation: Move database work to an appropriate coroutine dispatcher or suspend DAO operation.

title: Room schema migration failure
symptom: App update crashes when opening an existing database.
consoleOutput: IllegalStateException: Migration from 1 to 2 was required
rootCauseSummary: Schema changed without a valid migration path.
fixRecommendation: Implement and test a versioned migration; preserve user data.

title: Android permission denied
symptom: Feature fails on a newer Android version.
rootCauseSummary: Runtime permission is missing or user denied it.
fixRecommendation: Check permission declaration, runtime request, and denial fallback.

title: Activity recreation loses form state
symptom: Rotating device clears entered values.
rootCauseSummary: State is stored only in a transient local variable.
fixRecommendation: Use rememberSaveable or ViewModel-backed state for appropriate fields.

title: WorkManager task never runs immediately
symptom: Scheduled background task does not start at requested exact time.
consoleOutput: Work remains ENQUEUED while constraints unmet
rootCauseSummary: WorkManager is deferrable and constraints or system scheduling delay execution.
fixRecommendation: Use WorkManager for deferrable persistent work and design for delayed execution.

title: Coroutine updates UI after screen leaves
symptom: A request completes after navigation and causes stale work.
consoleOutput: Result applied after destination is disposed
rootCauseSummary: Coroutine lifecycle is not tied to ViewModel or screen scope.
fixRecommendation: Use lifecycle-aware collection and structured concurrency; cancel obsolete work.

title: Android emulator has no network
symptom: App cannot reach a service from the emulator.
consoleOutput: Connection to localhost:8080 refused in emulator
rootCauseSummary: Host loopback address is confused with emulator loopback or emulator network is unavailable.
fixRecommendation: Use the emulator host alias where appropriate and verify service binding/firewall.

title: Android cleartext traffic blocked
symptom: Development HTTP endpoint fails on device.
rootCauseSummary: Network security policy blocks cleartext HTTP.
fixRecommendation: Prefer HTTPS; for a controlled lab, configure a narrowly scoped debug-only exception.

title: Compose navigation controller duplicated
symptom: Back stack behaves inconsistently.
consoleOutput: Back action returns to unexpected screen
rootCauseSummary: Multiple controllers or misplaced NavHost instances create separate back stacks.
fixRecommendation: Use a clearly scoped NavController and one intended NavHost per navigation graph.

title: Android JSON asset parse failure
symptom: Scenario list is empty after adding an asset.
rootCauseSummary: Asset filename/path, JSON shape, enum spelling, or parser expectation differs.
fixRecommendation: Validate the asset path and required fields against the actual model and parser.

title: Binary search fails on sorted array
symptom: Search misses an element near the end.
rootCauseSummary: Midpoint or boundary update discards a valid candidate.
fixRecommendation: Maintain a clear inclusive/exclusive interval invariant and test boundary cases.

title: Off-by-one in array loop
symptom: Last element is skipped or an index exception occurs.
rootCauseSummary: Loop bound confuses array length with last valid index.
fixRecommendation: Use index < size for zero-based arrays and test empty/single-element inputs.

title: Quicksort worst-case performance
symptom: Sorting an already sorted list becomes very slow.
consoleOutput: Comparisons grow close to n squared
rootCauseSummary: Pivot selection repeatedly creates highly unbalanced partitions.
fixRecommendation: Use randomized/median pivot strategy or introspective sorting and measure complexity.

title: BFS returns wrong shortest path
symptom: Path length is not minimal in an unweighted graph.
consoleOutput: A node is enqueued multiple times with different parents
rootCauseSummary: Nodes are marked visited too late or queue discipline is incorrect.
fixRecommendation: Mark discovered nodes when enqueued and use FIFO queue.

title: DFS infinite traversal on cyclic graph
symptom: Traversal loops repeatedly between two nodes.
consoleOutput: A -> B -> C -> A repeats indefinitely
rootCauseSummary: Visited set is missing or incorrectly scoped.
fixRecommendation: Track visited vertices and distinguish directed/undirected edge handling.

title: Dijkstra negative edge result
symptom: Shortest-path output is incorrect with negative weights.
rootCauseSummary: Dijkstra assumes non-negative edge weights.
fixRecommendation: Validate weights or use an algorithm designed for negative edges, such as Bellman-Ford.

title: Hash map collision handling bug
symptom: Distinct keys overwrite each other.
consoleOutput: Two keys with same hash return same value
rootCauseSummary: Hash collision is treated as key equality.
fixRecommendation: Use equality after hashing and correctly handle collisions.

title: Linked list deletion corrupts list
symptom: Deleting a middle node loses the remaining tail.
rootCauseSummary: Next pointer is not relinked before removing node.
fixRecommendation: Update predecessor links and handle head/tail/empty cases explicitly.

title: Heap property violated
symptom: Priority queue returns a non-minimal item.
consoleOutput: Parent key exceeds child key in min-heap
rootCauseSummary: Heapify or parent/child index calculations are wrong.
fixRecommendation: Check parent-child invariant after each insertion and removal.

title: Dynamic programming wrong base case
symptom: Fibonacci or knapsack values are incorrect for small input.
rootCauseSummary: Base cases or state transitions do not match the recurrence.
fixRecommendation: Write the recurrence and validate n=0, n=1, and minimal capacity cases.

title: LCS table indexing error
symptom: Longest common subsequence length is too large.
rootCauseSummary: DP table indexes or recurrence use the wrong neighboring cells.
fixRecommendation: Use a table with a zero border and test empty-string cases.

title: Graph topological sort cycle
symptom: Topological sort cannot process all vertices.
rootCauseSummary: Directed graph contains a cycle.
fixRecommendation: Detect remaining indegree-positive vertices and report a cycle rather than returning an incomplete order.

title: Union-find parent chain slow
symptom: Disjoint set operations degrade over time.
consoleOutput: Find operation traverses a long parent chain
rootCauseSummary: Path compression or union by rank/size is missing.
fixRecommendation: Apply path compression and union by rank or size.

title: Big-O estimate incorrect
symptom: Algorithm expected linear but doubles runtime repeatedly.
consoleOutput: Doubling n increases runtime about fourfold
rootCauseSummary: Nested loops or repeated copying create superlinear work.
fixRecommendation: Count dominant operations and measure growth across increasing input sizes.

title: Circular queue full/empty confusion
symptom: Queue overwrites data or appears permanently full.
consoleOutput: front equals rear for both full and empty
rootCauseSummary: Head/tail representation does not distinguish full from empty correctly.
fixRecommendation: Use a count or reserved slot and test wraparound transitions.

title: Linux command not found
symptom: Shell cannot execute an installed utility.
rootCauseSummary: Executable is absent or its directory is not in PATH.
fixRecommendation: Check command path and environment; install from trusted repositories if absent.

title: Linux script permission denied
symptom: A shell script exists but cannot run.
rootCauseSummary: Execute bit missing, parent directory inaccessible, or mount is noexec.
fixRecommendation: Inspect permissions and mount settings before applying the minimum required change.

title: PATH selects wrong executable
symptom: A program runs an unexpected version.
consoleOutput: command -v python points to an old environment
rootCauseSummary: An earlier PATH entry shadows the intended binary.
fixRecommendation: Use command -v and inspect PATH order; invoke the verified path.

title: Package manager dependency conflict
symptom: Installing a package fails due to incompatible dependencies.
rootCauseSummary: Repository versions or pinned packages cannot satisfy constraints.
fixRecommendation: Inspect package manager diagnostics and repository priorities; avoid force-removing core dependencies.

title: SSH public key authentication fails
symptom: SSH asks for a password despite a configured key.
rootCauseSummary: Wrong key, permissions, username, authorized_keys, or server policy.
fixRecommendation: Use verbose SSH diagnostics and verify key/permissions without exposing private keys.

title: Cron job environment differs
symptom: A script works interactively but fails in cron.
consoleOutput: cron: command not found for expected utility
rootCauseSummary: Cron has a limited environment and different working directory.
fixRecommendation: Use absolute paths, define required environment, and log stdout/stderr.

title: Disk space exhausted
symptom: A build fails while writing temporary files.
rootCauseSummary: Filesystem has no free blocks or inodes.
fixRecommendation: Check df -h and df -i and identify safe cleanup candidates.

title: Symbolic link broken
symptom: A tool cannot open a linked resource.
consoleOutput: No such file or directory when following symlink
rootCauseSummary: Symlink target was moved or removed.
fixRecommendation: Inspect with ls -l/readlink and restore or update the intended target.

title: File descriptor limit reached
symptom: Service cannot open another socket.
rootCauseSummary: Process or system descriptor limit is exhausted.
fixRecommendation: Inspect process descriptor count and limits; fix leaks before raising limits.

title: Environment variable not exported
symptom: Child process cannot see a configured variable.
rootCauseSummary: Variable exists in shell but was not exported to child processes.
fixRecommendation: Export the variable in the correct shell/session or configure service environment.

title: Pipe exits with misleading status
symptom: Pipeline appears successful although the first command failed.
rootCauseSummary: Shell reports only the last pipeline command status by default.
fixRecommendation: Use pipefail where supported and check each command’s status.

title: grep pattern interpreted as regex
symptom: Search returns unexpected matches.
rootCauseSummary: Special characters are treated as regular-expression operators.
fixRecommendation: Use fixed-string mode for literal searches or escape the intended pattern.

title: Ownership mismatch in service directory
symptom: Service cannot write generated files.
rootCauseSummary: Files are owned by another user or directory permissions disallow writes.
fixRecommendation: Inspect ownership and grant the service account only required access.

title: Systemd service restart loop
symptom: Service repeatedly starts and exits.
rootCauseSummary: Configuration error, missing dependency, or incorrect ExecStart causes failure.
fixRecommendation: Inspect journal logs and unit configuration before changing restart policy.

title: Timezone mismatch in logs
symptom: Events appear out of order across systems.
consoleOutput: Same event differs by eight hours between logs
rootCauseSummary: Systems use different time zones or timestamps are parsed as local time.
fixRecommendation: Use UTC timestamps with explicit offsets and verify system clock synchronization.

title: TLS certificate expired
symptom: Secure connection fails after certificate expiry.
rootCauseSummary: The certificate validity period has ended.
fixRecommendation: Renew and deploy the certificate chain; verify automated renewal and monitoring.

title: Certificate chain incomplete
symptom: Some clients reject an HTTPS service while others connect.
consoleOutput: unable to get local issuer certificate
rootCauseSummary: Server omits an intermediate certificate required to build trust.
fixRecommendation: Configure the complete intermediate chain and validate with multiple clients.

title: Least privilege violation
symptom: Lab app can read unrelated database tables.
consoleOutput: Application account has global write privileges
rootCauseSummary: Service account has broader grants than required.
fixRecommendation: Restrict permissions to required tables/actions and review role assignments.

title: Secret committed to Git
symptom: Repository scan detects an API key in source history.
consoleOutput: Secret scanning alert for committed token
rootCauseSummary: A credential was committed as a literal or configuration file.
fixRecommendation: Revoke/rotate it immediately, remove it from active code, and follow history-cleanup policy.

title: Password hash stored in plaintext
symptom: Database dump exposes user passwords directly.
rootCauseSummary: Application stores original passwords rather than salted adaptive hashes.
fixRecommendation: Use a vetted password hashing function such as Argon2id, scrypt, or bcrypt with appropriate parameters.

title: SQL injection in login form
symptom: Special input alters query logic.
consoleOutput: Input changes the structure of a SQL WHERE clause
rootCauseSummary: Credentials are interpolated into SQL strings.
fixRecommendation: Use parameterized queries and generic authentication errors.

title: Insecure direct object reference
symptom: Changing an ID reveals another student’s report.
rootCauseSummary: Server checks authentication but not object-level authorization.
fixRecommendation: Authorize every resource against the current user and tenant.

title: Cross-site scripting output
symptom: A comment renders executable markup.
consoleOutput: User-supplied markup executes in page context
rootCauseSummary: Untrusted text is inserted into HTML without context-appropriate escaping.
fixRecommendation: Use framework escaping and sanitize only where rich HTML is intentionally supported.

title: CSRF on state-changing request
symptom: A logged-in user triggers an unintended change from another site.
consoleOutput: POST request accepted without anti-CSRF validation
rootCauseSummary: Cookie-authenticated state-changing endpoint lacks suitable CSRF defenses.
fixRecommendation: Use framework CSRF protection, suitable SameSite cookies, and origin checks as appropriate.

title: Overly broad CORS policy
symptom: Sensitive API allows arbitrary origins with credentials.
rootCauseSummary: CORS trust policy is configured too broadly.
fixRecommendation: Allow explicit trusted origins and avoid credentialed wildcard configurations.

title: Unsafe file upload type
symptom: A file upload is trusted based only on filename extension.
consoleOutput: Uploaded executable content saved under public directory
rootCauseSummary: Client-controlled metadata is treated as proof of content type.
fixRecommendation: Validate size and content, store outside executable web roots, and use safe generated filenames.

title: Dependency with known vulnerability
symptom: Build audit reports a vulnerable transitive library.
consoleOutput: Dependency scanner flags vulnerable transitive package
rootCauseSummary: A dependency version contains a published security issue.
fixRecommendation: Confirm reachability and upgrade to a fixed compatible version; test regression suite.

title: Session not invalidated on logout
symptom: Old session token continues to work after logout.
rootCauseSummary: Logout clears only client state while server-side session remains valid.
fixRecommendation: Invalidate server-side session/token and rotate session identifiers after authentication changes.

title: Rate limiting absent
symptom: Login endpoint accepts repeated attempts without throttling.
consoleOutput: Many failed attempts from one source are accepted
rootCauseSummary: No suitable abuse controls exist for repeated authentication attempts.
fixRecommendation: Add adaptive rate limits and monitoring without enabling easy account-lockout denial of service.

title: Debug mode exposes internals
symptom: Production error page shows stack traces and environment details.
consoleOutput: HTTP 500 response includes filesystem paths and stack trace
rootCauseSummary: Development diagnostics are enabled in production.
fixRecommendation: Disable debug mode and return safe error identifiers while logging details privately.

title: CSV shifted columns
symptom: Rows appear under the wrong headings after import.
consoleOutput: Row has 9 fields while header has 7
rootCauseSummary: Delimiter, quoting, or embedded newline handling is incorrect.
fixRecommendation: Use a CSV parser and inspect delimiter/quote conventions rather than splitting lines manually.

title: Pandas KeyError column missing
symptom: Notebook fails when selecting a column.
rootCauseSummary: Column label differs due to spelling, whitespace, or header parsing.
fixRecommendation: Inspect df.columns and normalize labels intentionally before selecting.

title: Pandas mixed data types
symptom: Numeric aggregation fails for a score column.
rootCauseSummary: Some rows contain text markers or malformed numeric values.
fixRecommendation: Inspect invalid values and convert with explicit error handling.

title: Missing values distort average
symptom: Reported average is much lower than expected.
consoleOutput: Mean includes 0 values for blank scores
rootCauseSummary: Missing values were encoded as zero instead of null, or denominator policy is wrong.
fixRecommendation: Inspect missingness and define an explicit imputation/exclusion rule.

title: Duplicate rows inflate metrics
symptom: Dataset row count is higher after combining exports.
rootCauseSummary: Same records were appended more than once.
fixRecommendation: Identify a reliable record key and deduplicate only under documented rules.

title: Train-test data leakage
symptom: Model performs extremely well in testing but poorly after deployment.
rootCauseSummary: Information from the test set or future data influenced training features.
fixRecommendation: Split before fitting preprocessing and ensure features exist at prediction time.

title: Class imbalance hides failure recall
symptom: Model has high accuracy but misses most failures.
rootCauseSummary: Majority class dominates the accuracy metric.
fixRecommendation: Inspect confusion matrix, recall, precision-recall curve, and class-aware validation.

title: Incorrect train-test split for time series
symptom: Forecast model performs unrealistically well.
consoleOutput: Random split metrics much higher than forward validation
rootCauseSummary: Random split leaks future patterns into training.
fixRecommendation: Use chronological splits and time-aware cross-validation.

title: Feature scaling leakage
symptom: Test metrics shift after adding standardization.
rootCauseSummary: Scaler was fit using the full dataset before splitting.
fixRecommendation: Fit preprocessing only on training data, ideally within a pipeline.

title: Pandas chained assignment ambiguity
symptom: An intended dataframe update is not reflected.
rootCauseSummary: A view/copy ambiguity causes assignment to affect a temporary object.
fixRecommendation: Use explicit .loc assignment and inspect the resulting dataframe.

title: Incorrect join key in analytics
symptom: Merged dataset has unexpectedly many rows.
rootCauseSummary: Join key is not unique or mismatched across source tables.
fixRecommendation: Check key uniqueness and expected join cardinality before merging.

title: Timezone parsing inconsistency
symptom: Daily totals are assigned to the wrong date.
consoleOutput: Events near midnight appear on adjacent dates
rootCauseSummary: Timestamps mix naive and timezone-aware values.
fixRecommendation: Parse with explicit timezone semantics and convert consistently before grouping.

title: Outlier silently removed
symptom: Analysis excludes legitimate high values.
rootCauseSummary: Generic thresholding treats valid rare cases as errors.
fixRecommendation: Investigate provenance and use domain-specific validation before exclusion.

title: Model label encoding mismatch
symptom: Production predictions map class labels incorrectly.
consoleOutput: Class index 1 mapped to "normal" instead of "failure"
rootCauseSummary: Training and inference use different label mappings.
fixRecommendation: Persist the fitted encoder/model pipeline and validate class ordering.

title: Reproducibility seed missing
symptom: Repeated experiments yield different results.
rootCauseSummary: Randomness and environment versions are not controlled or recorded.
fixRecommendation: Record seeds, package versions, data version, and split strategy.

title: Unit test order dependency
symptom: A test passes alone but fails in the full suite.
consoleOutput: Test fails only after another test modifies settings
rootCauseSummary: Tests share mutable global state or depend on execution order.
fixRecommendation: Reset fixtures and isolate test state between cases.

title: Mock not injected
symptom: Test unexpectedly calls a real external service.
consoleOutput: Unexpected network request during unit test
rootCauseSummary: Production dependency was not replaced by the test double.
fixRecommendation: Verify dependency injection wiring and assert the mock interaction.

title: Flaky asynchronous test
symptom: Test sometimes fails because result arrives late.
rootCauseSummary: Test relies on arbitrary sleep rather than completion signal.
fixRecommendation: Await a deterministic condition or use coroutine/test scheduler support.

title: Boundary condition not tested
symptom: Algorithm fails for empty input in production.
rootCauseSummary: Tests cover normal values but omit boundary cases.
fixRecommendation: Add empty, single-item, min/max, and invalid-input tests.

title: Regression after refactor
symptom: Previously working workflow fails after internal changes.
consoleOutput: Existing scenario completion no longer records attempt
rootCauseSummary: Behavioral contract was not covered by tests or integration wiring changed.
fixRecommendation: Reproduce with a focused regression test and validate related integration paths.

title: API contract test mismatch
symptom: Client expects one field type but server returns another.
consoleOutput: Expected integer score but response contains string
rootCauseSummary: Schema changed without coordinated versioning or contract tests.
fixRecommendation: Define and validate request/response schemas in CI.

title: Test fixture timezone failure
symptom: Date assertion fails on another machine.
rootCauseSummary: Test assumes local timezone or current date.
fixRecommendation: Use fixed clocks and explicit timezone-aware timestamps.

title: Database test contamination
symptom: One test sees records created by a previous test.
rootCauseSummary: Test database is not reset or transactions are not isolated.
fixRecommendation: Use isolated test databases, cleanup, or rollback strategy.

title: Snapshot test too brittle
symptom: Small harmless UI change breaks many snapshots.
consoleOutput: Hundreds of snapshot diffs after spacing change
rootCauseSummary: Snapshot assertions encode incidental rendering details.
fixRecommendation: Assert meaningful behavior and update snapshots only after review.

title: Coverage mistaken for quality
symptom: High coverage exists but important failures are not detected.
consoleOutput: 100% line coverage with no failure-path assertions
rootCauseSummary: Coverage measures execution, not assertion strength or scenario quality.
fixRecommendation: Review assertions, mutation sensitivity, and risk-based edge cases.

title: Build succeeds locally but fails CI
symptom: CI fails at compilation or tests.
rootCauseSummary: Toolchain, environment, cached artifacts, or OS differs.
fixRecommendation: Use reproducible build configuration and inspect exact CI environment/version.

title: Performance test not representative
symptom: Benchmark is fast but users experience slow requests.
rootCauseSummary: Test data size, concurrency, warmup, or network conditions do not reflect production.
fixRecommendation: Use realistic workload distributions and report percentiles, not only averages.

title: Property-based test finds rare failure
symptom: Random input exposes a bug not covered by examples.
rootCauseSummary: Algorithm assumes input ordering or invariant that is not guaranteed.
fixRecommendation: Minimize the failing example and add it as a regression case.

title: Test environment secret missing
symptom: Integration tests fail in clean runner.
rootCauseSummary: Required test configuration is not provisioned securely.
fixRecommendation: Use CI secret configuration and safe test-only services; never hardcode credentials.

title: Accessibility test failure
symptom: Screen reader cannot identify an action button.
rootCauseSummary: Interactive element lacks a meaningful accessible label or semantics.
fixRecommendation: Add descriptive semantics and verify with accessibility checks and assistive technology.
